a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan of operating up to 8 cells will very likely get us both killed. Only about 20% of episodes even reach round 2, and we would need 2 operate rounds. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the deal quietly. Ideas: a fair coin-style split, where one of us takes the 4 now, or something better if you see it. What do you propose? I'll tell you my real next action, and I won't take while claiming to operate.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep the agreement and operate. I'm not taking early. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
